title: Stale Profile Data Cleanup for Aether/CRT-GroundCheck

steps.title: PHASE 1 - AUDIT & BACKUP: Export full SQLite memory DB snapshot before any mutations. Timestamp the backup. Query total entry count and date range for baseline.
PHASE 2 - IDENTIFY PRE-GATE ENTRIES: Determine the epistemic gate go-live date. Query all self-model entries with timestamps BEFORE that date. Flag these as 'pre-gate contamination candidates'.

PHASE 3 - DEDUPLICATION PASS: Identify duplicate entries (e.g., the 46 'favorite color' duplicates). For each duplicate cluster: keep the entry with highest trust score OR most recent timestamp. Mark others for deletion.

PHASE 4 - EPISTEMIC VALIDATION: Run surviving pre-gate entries through the Continuity Auditor. Reject entries that fail the epistemic gate (unsupported claims, contradictions). Flag entries that pass for manual review.
PHASE 5 - STAGED PURGE: Soft-delete flagged entries first (add 'deleted' flag rather than hard delete). Verify system stability. After 7-day hold period, hard-delete soft-deleted entries.
PHASE 6 - VERIFICATION: Re-run entry count and duplicate detection. Confirm no regressions. Document what was purged and why for audit trail.
